# pidginhost_private_network (Resource)

A private network. Connect servers to it with `pidginhost_private_network_attachment`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_private_network" "backend" {
  address = "10.10.0.0/24"
  gateway = "10.10.0.1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Address range in CIDR format, for example `10.10.0.0/24`. Changing it replaces the network.

### Optional

- `gateway` (String) Gateway address inside the network. Can be changed or removed in place.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Private network ID.
- `provisioned` (Boolean) Whether the network has been provisioned on the platform.
- `slug` (String) Slug of the network (its CIDR, as returned by the API).

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>

Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a private network by its ID.
terraform import pidginhost_private_network.backend 123
```
